Uslovnye znaki: chasti goroda -obyvatel'skaia, fabrichno-zavodskaia, pristanskaia, dorogi - proselochnye, zheleznye, chugunnyi reper. Otmecheny: nomera kvartalov, ploshchadi s nazvaniiami, tserkvi, granitsa nadela, kolodtsy, vodomernyi post, proektiruemai.
